description: Rules for the gazetteer layer (27-GAZETTEER.md): which features of each authority form the backbone, how the trees are drawn, and how ancient places reach the modern tree. Code names no thresholds or codes: it follows this file.

modernTree.note: Countries and dependencies are the rows of countryInfo.txt (each names its own geonameid and continent); other PCL* and TERR features, historical divisions (ADM1H ...), and divisions of no level (ADMD) stay out of the strict tree.

bridge.note: An ancient place reaches the modern tree through a GeoNames feature Pleiades names, else the nearest GeoNames populated place within maxKm (curator, 2026-10-14), whose admin codes give the most specific unit; beyond maxKm no link is made and the place is listed.
